Good to Know

Do you take walk-ins or appointments?

Both, but booking ahead means no wait and your favorite tech. Book right here in seconds.

How long does gel or dip last?

Typically two to three weeks with proper care, with no chips.

Do you do custom nail art?

Yes, from simple accents to full custom designs. Bring your inspiration.

Are your tools sanitized?

Always. Tools are fully sanitized between every client for your safety.
